title: Investigaciones arqueológicas en Palanda, Santa Ana-La Florida
version: Arqueología Alto Amazónica, pp. 222–245, §8.2. IRD institutional copy of the original bilingual excavation report chapter.
lineage: Primary excavation context, including reported residue observations later studied by Zarrillo and coauthors. Same site and overlapping investigators, not independent chemical replication.

passages.note: The excavator reports cacao and maize starch in ceramic bridge-handled bottles and describes these vessels in the context of funerary offerings. Cacao signals are reported in stone and ceramic vessels. The claimed identity of a specific fermented beverage is an interpretation.
